property-details.property-description:
Property Overview

This four-unit building is ideal for tenants and investors seeking private, self-contained apartments. The property includes two 2-bedroom apartments and two 1-bedroom apartments; units are rented as whole apartments (not by the room).

The units feature fully equipped kitchens, comfortable living areas, and dedicated spaces suitable for work or relaxation. Modern appliances and tasteful, low-maintenance finishes make the apartments easy to maintain.

Amenities

  • Fully equipped kitchen with modern appliances
  • Comfortable bedrooms with quality linens
  • Smart TV with streaming services
  • Free on-site parking
  • Heating and air conditioning

Note: No internet is provided on-site. No washer or dryer is available in the Luttrell units.

Lease: 1-year lease term. Check-in: No self check-in available; arrivals must be coordinated with management.

Location

Located in Knoxville with easy access to downtown, dining, shopping, and several nearby craft breweries.
